title: Leonida Platinum Guide v2 — GTA VI trophy guide & tracker

sources.label: Exophase — GTA VI PSN trophy list
sources.covers: Official names, descriptions and grades for all 55 trophies; re-checked live 21 Nov 2026.

sources.label: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies
sources.covers: PSN progress targets (counts) per trophy, where one exists.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.covers: Platinum roadmap: difficulty 4/10, about 200 hours, story chapters, 100% checklist, missable note.

sources.label: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List
sources.covers: Full 55-trophy list; 28 hidden trophies; story-spoiler warnings.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
sources.covers: Roadmap steps; Chapter 1 meditation detail; 200-hour estimate; 1 potentially missable trophy.

sources.label: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies, the full official list
sources.covers: List as shown by PlayStation/Xbox since launch; PowerPyx roadmap summary; 80 challenges in 8 groups of 10.

sources.label: GTA Six Insider — GTA 6 Trophy List
sources.covers: Full list with short unlock notes; story vs non-story split.

sources.label: Vice City Hustle — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies
sources.covers: List compiled from PowerPyx and GTABase; difficulty 4/10; about 200 hours; 18 meditation spots in 10 locations.

sources.label: Take-Two / Rockstar Games — Trailer 2 press release
sources.covers: Trailer 2 release; game then set for May 26, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S; footage captured on PS5.

sources.label: Rockstar Games — GTA VI official page
sources.covers: Official game page; launch November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

disagreements.a: PowerPyx and KeenGamer count only 1 trophy that can truly lock the platinum: Positive Mental Attitude, whose first meditation can only be done in Chapter 1. [S3][S5]
disagreements.b: This guide flags 13 one-time moments, because each can only be done when it appears and no mission replay is confirmed. [S3]
disagreements.call: Both are right at different strictness: only 1 can lock the platinum, but all 13 need doing when they appear.

disagreements.topic: How many chapters does the story have?
disagreements.a: The official trophy descriptions name Chapters 1-4 plus a final mission. [S1]
disagreements.b: PowerPyx's roadmap describes the story as 5 chapters taking 60-80 hours. [S3]
disagreements.call: This guide follows the trophy descriptions (Ch. 1-4 + finale) and flags the difference; the roadmap order is the same either way.

disagreements.a: Exophase and PSNProfiles list 28 hidden trophies. [S1][S2]
disagreements.b: Some lists print the story trophy names outright, so they count fewer hidden trophies (26 in one count). [S6]
disagreements.call: 28 is the tracker count used here; the gap is story trophies that are hidden on PSN but named in some lists.

disagreements.a: PowerPyx and KeenGamer estimate about 200 hours at difficulty 4/10. [S3][S5]
disagreements.b: A shorter estimate of 100-200 hours at difficulty 7/10 circulates in other round-ups, but this guide could not pin it to a dated source.
disagreements.call: This guide uses about 200 hours and 4/10, the two-source figure; treat 100 hours as the fast end, not the plan.

disagreements.a: PSNProfiles lists a 500 target for Actions Speak Louder. [S2]
disagreements.b: The official description only says 'Choices made (for better or worse)' and names nothing countable. [S1]
disagreements.call: UNRESOLVED: no source pins down what the 500 counts. This guide says so instead of guessing.
The May 2026 date was superseded; every date in this guide uses the real launch.

disagreements.a: The official list names it 'Strangers & Freaks'. [S1][S2]
disagreements.b: GTA Six Insider's table prints 'Stranger & Freaks'. [S7]
disagreements.call: Official spelling wins; the other is a typo in that list.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.answer: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum is yours. [S1][S3]
trophies.guide: The platinum is the last trophy you will earn, because it only pops once every other trophy is done. There is no shortcut: it is the sum of the story, the stranger strands, the activities, the collectibles and the long grinds, in that order.
steps: Finish the story and its final mission first; that clears the chapter and mission trophies. [S1]
Work the roadmap in order: stranger strands, then activities and exploration, then collectibles and money. [S3]
Clear the 100% completion checklist last; it is the longest single job in the game. [S3]
The platinum pops the moment your 54th other trophy lands, so keep this tracker open and tick each one as it comes. [S1]
tips: PowerPyx puts the whole run at about 200 hours and difficulty 4/10, with zero online trophies. [S3]

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.answer: Play the Gone Fishing mission to the end. [S1]
trophies.guide: The first story mission of the game, and the gentlest trophy in the list. Gone Fishing is a story mission, so it comes to you: follow the story prompts, finish the mission, and the trophy pops at the results screen.
steps: Start the story and follow the opening prompts until Gone Fishing begins. [S1]
Play the mission through; it is a fishing trip, so expect a slow, guided introduction. [S1]
Finish the mission and the trophy pops at the end; nothing extra is needed. [S1]
tips: Fishing returns later as a challenge against Cal, so learn the casting here — it pays off at trophy 20. [S1][S5]

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.answer: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. [S1]
trophies.guide: A chapter trophy: it pops when the last mission of Chapter 1 is done. Chapter 1 is also where the first meditation spot sits, so while you are here, meditate once — KeenGamer flags that spot as the one meditation that cannot be done later.
steps: Play Chapter 1's missions in order; the story carries you through them. [S1]
Meditate at the Chapter 1 spot while you are here — it is the one meditation that may not come back. [S5]
Finish the chapter's final mission and the trophy pops. [S1]
tips: Chapter 1 is short; expect about an hour or two of story. [S3]

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.answer: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. [S1]
trophies.guide: The Chapter 2 trophy. Keep playing the story missions in order and it arrives on its own — there is nothing to hunt for, no side task to finish first, and no way to miss it as long as you keep playing.
steps: Continue the story into Chapter 2 after Chapter 1 ends. [S1]
Play the chapter's missions in order; the trophy follows the story, not a checklist. [S1]
Finish the chapter's final mission and the trophy pops. [S1]
tips: Side strands open up around now; this guide puts them in Phase 2, after the story. [S6]

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.answer: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. [S1]
trophies.guide: The Chapter 3 trophy, and the one whose name says it all: by now you are deep in Vice City. Play the chapter through; the trophy pops at the chapter's end, and nothing in it can be missed.
steps: Continue the story into Chapter 3 after Chapter 2 ends. [S1]
Play the chapter's missions in order. [S1]
Finish the chapter's final mission and the trophy pops. [S1]
tips: By Chapter 3 most of Leonida is open; start noting vehicle and location counts for the Phase 3 trophies. [S3][S5]

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.answer: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. [S1]
trophies.guide: The Chapter 4 trophy. One chapter remains after this one — the finale — so this is the last of the four chapter trophies. Play it through in order and it pops at the chapter's end.
steps: Continue the story into Chapter 4 after Chapter 3 ends. [S1]
Play the chapter's missions in order. [S1]
Finish the chapter's final mission and the trophy pops. [S1]
tips: Before the finale, grab any one-time moments you have skipped; the missables list on this guide shows all 13. [S3]

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.answer: Finish the game's final mission. [S1]
trophies.guide: The gold trophy for beating the story. The final mission follows Chapter 4, and finishing it closes the story arc — Lucia and Jason's run through Leonida ends here, and the credits roll with this trophy.
steps: Finish Chapter 4 to unlock the final mission. [S1]
Play the final mission through to its end. [S1]
The trophy pops when the mission completes; the story is done. [S1]
tips: PowerPyx puts the story at 60-80 hours across the chapters; take your time, the post-story cleanup is most of the platinum. [S3]

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.answer: Complete the Breakfast Run story mission. [S1]
trophies.guide: A story-mission trophy: Breakfast Run is one of the named missions in the campaign, and finishing it is all this trophy asks. It is unmissable in the sense that the mission always appears in the story; just play it when it comes.
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in the story; it appears as a story mission. [S1]
Play the mission through to its end. [S1]
The trophy pops at the mission results screen. [S1]
tips: Named-mission trophies like this one need no special approach — just finish the mission. [S3]

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.answer: Complete The Cartel Heist story mission. [S1]
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is one of the story's big set-piece missions, and its trophy is simply for finishing it. Expect a longer mission than the early ones — a heist, with planning and a getaway — and the trophy pops when it is done.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story. [S1]
Play the heist through, including the escape. [S1]
The trophy pops when the mission completes. [S1]
tips: Heist missions are good practice for the bank-vault robberies later (trophy 40). [S1]

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.answer: Complete the Child's Play story mission. [S1]
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a named story mission, and finishing it earns this trophy. Play it when it appears in the story; there is no extra objective and no way to miss it.
steps: Reach Child's Play in the story. [S1]
Play the mission through to its end. [S1]
The trophy pops at the mission results screen. [S1]
tips: Mission trophies 8-13 all work the same way: finish the named mission. [S1]

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.answer: Complete the Headliners story mission. [S1]
trophies.guide: Headliners is a named story mission, and its trophy is for finishing it. Play the mission when it appears; the trophy follows the mission's end, with no extra objective attached.
steps: Reach Headliners in the story. [S1]
Play the mission through to its end. [S1]
The trophy pops at the mission results screen. [S1]
tips: If a mission ever feels hard, drop the difficulty in the pause menu — trophies do not care what difficulty you play on. [S3]

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.answer: Complete the VCIA Takedown story mission. [S1]
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a named story mission set around Vice City International Airport — the same airport that hides one of the missable trophies. Finish the mission and the trophy pops; while you are at the airport, remember the unscheduled departure for trophy 37.
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story. [S1]
Play the mission through to its end. [S1]
The trophy pops at the mission results screen. [S1]
tips: The airport is also home to trophy 37's one-time moment, so keep it in mind while you are here. [S1]

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.answer: Complete the Operation Savage Glory story mission. [S1]
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is the last of the named-mission trophies. It is a story mission like the others in this run: play it when it appears, finish it, and the trophy pops at the end.
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story. [S1]
Play the mission through to its end. [S1]
The trophy pops at the mission results screen. [S1]
tips: With this mission done, the story-mission trophies 8-13 are all complete. [S1]

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.answer: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist. [S1][S3]
trophies.guide: The gold trophy for 100% completion, and the longest single job in the game after the story. The checklist covers story missions, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and challenges; PowerPyx puts this job alone at about 100 hours. Start its counts early — most of them tick up while you do other trophies.
steps: Open the in-game 100% checklist and read what it counts; it is the only complete list of what this trophy needs. [S3]
Finish the story and all stranger strands first; they are the biggest blocks on the checklist. [S3]
Work through the activities, collectibles and challenges in Phases 2-4; each one feeds this checklist. [S3]
GTA Spotter notes the challenge block is 80 challenges in 8 groups of 10, and PowerPyx's roadmap says 70 of 80 are needed for the checklist. [S6][S3]
When the checklist reads 100%, the trophy pops. [S1]
tips: Do not leave this to the very end without checking the list — a single missed strand can hide for hours. [S3]

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.answer: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. [S1][S2]
trophies.guide: Two hundred and fifty stunts: jumps, near misses, long airtime, and everything the game counts as a stunt. It is a grind, but it happens mostly by itself — drive fast, take jumps, and use the tracker counter here to watch the number climb.
steps: Drive, jump and drift around Leonida; the game counts stunts as you pull them off. [S1]
Use ramps and jumps you already know — repeating a good jump counts every time. [S1]
Check the counter in this guide's tracker to see how far along you are. [S2]
Keep at it across Phase 3 and the cleanup; 250 is a lot, but it stacks with the driving you do anyway. [S1]
tips: Stunts also feed the 100% checklist, so this grind is never wasted. [S3]

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.answer: Try each of the 9 activity types once. [S1][S2]
trophies.guide: A sampler trophy: try every kind of activity in the game once. You do not need to win or master any of them — one try each is enough. The nine types cover the activities Leonida offers, from racing to fishing to the shooting range.
steps: Open the activities list in the game and note the 9 types it shows. [S1]
Try one of each type — a race, a fishing spot, the range, and the rest — one attempt each. [S1]
Use the counter here to mark each type as you try it, so none gets forgotten. [S2]
The trophy pops when the ninth type is tried. [S1]
tips: Do this early in Phase 3; it maps every activity for the harder trophies that follow. [S3]

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.answer: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. [S1][S2]
trophies.guide: The hardest activity trophy: every one of the 42 range challenges needs a gold-medal score. Accuracy and speed both matter, and each challenge is built around a particular weapon, so learn the layout first and use the weapon the challenge expects.
steps: Visit a shooting range and open its challenge list. [S1]
Play a challenge until you earn its gold medal. [S1]
Use the weapon the challenge is built around; a familiar gun beats a powerful one. [S1]
Repeat across all 42 challenges; the tracker holds your gold count. [S2]
tips: The 100% checklist also needs every shooting range done, so this feeds A Long Road too. [S3]

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.answer: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. [S1][S2]
trophies.guide: Fourteen drone races, one win at each location. Drone racing is its own skill — tight turns, low altitude, and clean lines beat raw speed. Learn one course at a time and move on once you have its win.
steps: Find a Top Fun Drone Race location and enter the race. [S1]
Win the race at that location; a win is what counts, not a fast time. [S1]
Move to the next location and repeat. [S1]
Use the counter here to track which of the 14 locations you have won. [S2]
tips: PowerPyx's roadmap groups drone races with the other activities in the mid-game cleanup. [S3]

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.answer: Win 20 different races. [S1][S2]
trophies.guide: Twenty wins, and each one has to be a different race — repeating your favourite does not count twice. Leonida's race calendar is wide, so work through the list: street races, off-road, and whatever else the map offers.
steps: Open the race list and pick a race you have not won yet. [S1]
Win it; only wins in new races count toward the 20. [S1]
Move to the next unwon race; the counter here tracks your wins. [S2]
The trophy pops on your 20th different win. [S1]
tips: A fast car you trust matters more than the fastest car on paper — pick one and learn it. [S1]

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.answer: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. [S1]
trophies.guide: Cal is the fishing rival, and this trophy is for beating him at his own game. You already learned to fish in Gone Fishing; now it is a contest. Watch his catch, beat his weight, and the trophy is yours.
steps: Find Cal and take his fishing challenge. [S1]
Fish the challenge through; the casting you learned in Gone Fishing applies here. [S1]
Out-fish Cal and the trophy pops when the challenge ends. [S1]
If you lose, try again — the challenge can be retried. [S1]
tips: KeenGamer's roadmap puts fishing among the early side activities, so do it in Phase 2. [S5]

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.answer: Complete any arcade game. [S1]
trophies.guide: The easiest activity trophy: finish one arcade game, anywhere. Arcades are scattered around Leonida; walk up to a machine, play it through, and the trophy pops when the game ends.
steps: Find an arcade machine in Leonida. [S1]
Start any arcade game and play it. [S1]
Finish the game and the trophy pops. [S1]
No score target is needed — completing is enough. [S1]
tips: Pick the shortest game on the machine if you only want the trophy fast. [S1]

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.answer: Complete Andy's final mission. [S1]
trophies.guide: Andy is one of the side characters with a mission strand of his own, and this trophy is for finishing his last mission. Side strands work like small stories: meet the character, play their missions in order, and the trophy pops at the end of the strand.
steps: Meet Andy and start his mission strand. [S1]
Play Andy's missions in order until the strand ends. [S1]
The trophy pops when his final mission completes. [S1]
tips: PowerPyx's roadmap notes Andy's strand is Lucia-only, so play it as Lucia. [S3]

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.answer: Complete Kenton's final mission. [S1]
trophies.guide: Kenton is another side character with a mission strand, and the trophy is for his final mission. Follow the strand through its missions and the trophy pops at the end — the boat in the name is a hint at how his story goes.
steps: Meet Kenton and start his mission strand. [S1]
Play Kenton's missions in order until the strand ends. [S1]
The trophy pops when his final mission completes. [S1]
tips: Side strands count toward the 100% checklist too, so none of this work is wasted. [S3]

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.answer: Complete Billy's final mission. [S1]
trophies.guide: Billy's strand is the third of the named side characters, and its trophy works the same way: play his missions in order, finish the last one, and the trophy pops. The lone rider of the name rides alone — expect missions built around bikes and the open road.
steps: Meet Billy and start his mission strand. [S1]
Play Billy's missions in order until the strand ends. [S1]
The trophy pops when his final mission completes. [S1]
tips: Keep a good bike handy for Billy's missions; the strand leans on riding. [S1]

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.answer: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. [S1][S2]
trophies.guide: The silver trophy for the stranger strands: eight full strands for the odd characters scattered across Leonida. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them; three more strangers wait out in the state. Each strand is its own small story, so this trophy is really five-plus mini-campaigns in one.
steps: Find stranger missions on the map — they appear as you explore Leonida. [S1]
Play each stranger's missions in order until their strand ends. [S1]
Count the finished strands in this guide's tracker; eight is the target. [S2]
The trophy pops when the eighth strand completes. [S1]
tips: GTA Six Insider splits the list into story and non-story; this trophy is the heart of the non-story half. [S7]
One list prints this trophy's name as 'Stranger & Freaks' — the official spelling is 'Strangers & Freaks' (see disagreement 7). [S1][S7]

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.answer: Complete Randy's final mission. [S1]
trophies.guide: Randy's strand is one of the stranger strands, and its trophy is for his final mission. Play his missions in order and the trophy pops at the end of the strand.
steps: Meet Randy and start his mission strand. [S1]
Play Randy's missions in order until the strand ends. [S1]
The trophy pops when his final mission completes. [S1]
tips: Randy's strand is one of the eight that count toward Strangers & Freaks (trophy 25). [S1]

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.answer: Complete Tyrone's final mission. [S1]
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand closes out the named side characters, and its trophy is for his final mission. Play his missions in order; the trophy pops when the strand ends.
steps: Meet Tyrone and start his mission strand. [S1]
Play Tyrone's missions in order until the strand ends. [S1]
The trophy pops when his final mission completes. [S1]
tips: PowerPyx's roadmap notes Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, so play it as Jason. [S3]

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.answer: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. [S1][S2]
trophies.guide: Eighteen meditation spots, and the one trophy the roadmaps warn about most: KeenGamer says the first spot can only be reached in Chapter 1, so meditate there before the chapter ends. After that, the rest are spread across Leonida in ten locations, and each one is a quiet moment — find the spot, sit, and meditate.
steps: Meditate at the Chapter 1 spot BEFORE Chapter 1 ends — this is the one that cannot be done later. [S5]
Find the remaining meditation spots across Leonida; Vice City Hustle counts 18 spots in 10 locations. [S8]
Meditate at each spot; the counter here tracks how many you have done. [S2]
PowerPyx and KeenGamer both call this the one trophy that can truly lock the platinum, so do the Chapter 1 spot first and the rest in Phase 3. [S3][S5]
The trophy pops when the 18th spot is meditated at. [S1]
tips: Do the Chapter 1 meditation during trophy 3, not after — that is the whole warning. [S5]

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.answer: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. [S1]
trophies.guide: Bret wants a unique animal hunted, and this trophy is for doing it. Hunting in Leonida means tracking the animal to its territory, taking the shot cleanly, and bringing the hunt home. The animal is unique, so there is only one of it — find Bret first and he will point you at the hunt.
steps: Meet Bret and take his hunting job. [S1]
Track the unique animal to where it lives. [S1]
Hunt it and complete the job for Bret. [S1]
The trophy pops when the hunt is done. [S1]
tips: PowerPyx's roadmap notes Bret's strand is Jason-only. [S3]

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.answer: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. [S1][S2]
trophies.guide: Three full sets of collectible cards, found across Leonida. Cards hide in shops, houses, and quiet corners of the map; a set is complete when every card in it is found. This is a Phase 4 cleanup job — slow, thorough, and best done with a map and a checklist.
steps: Find collectible cards as you explore; each card belongs to a set. [S1]
Complete one full set, then a second, then a third. [S1]
Use the counter here to track finished sets — three is the target. [S2]
The trophy pops when the third set is complete. [S1]
tips: KeenGamer's roadmap groups card sets with the other collectibles in the final cleanup. [S5]

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.answer: WAiNK It at 100 locations. [S1][S2]
trophies.guide: One hundred WAiNK spots, each one a small act of Leonida vandalism-with-a-camera. The WAiNK app marks the spots; visit one, use it, and move on. It is a long list, so treat it as a tour of the state and tick the counter as you go.
steps: Open the WAiNK app and find a marked location. [S1]
WAiNK It at that location. [S1]
Move to the next location; the counter here tracks your 100. [S2]
The trophy pops at the 100th location. [S1]
tips: Pair this with exploring Leonida (trophy 42) — the routes overlap. [S1][S5]

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.answer: Complete 50 challenges. [S1][S2]
trophies.guide: Fifty challenges from the game's challenge list. GTA Spotter counts 80 challenges in total, in 8 groups of 10, and PowerPyx's roadmap says 70 of 80 feed the 100% checklist — so these fifty overlap heavily with the platinum's longest job. Pick the groups you like and work through them.
steps: Open the challenges list and pick a group to work on. [S6]
Complete challenges one by one; the counter here tracks your 50. [S2]
Work across groups — there are 8 groups of 10, so you have room to choose. [S6]
The trophy pops on your 50th completed challenge. [S1]
tips: Challenges you finish for other trophies count here too, so this number climbs on its own. [S3]

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.answer: With your partner, reach a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose it and escape. [S1]
trophies.guide: A partner trophy, and a missable one: you need your partner beside you, a 4-star Wanted Level, and a clean escape — all in the same moment. The chance comes during story moments when you and your partner are together; if you are playing with your partner nearby, build the heat on purpose and then break away.
steps: Wait for a story moment when your partner is with you. [S1]
Build your Wanted Level to 4 stars while your partner is beside you. [S1]
Lose the Wanted Level and escape the heat together. [S1]
tips: No mission replay is confirmed, so do this the first time the chance appears — see the missables page. [S3]

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.answer: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your Wanted Level. [S1]
trophies.guide: Three shops, back to back, with your partner, and without losing the Wanted Level between them. The trick is the chain: rob one shop, move straight to the next, and keep the heat on the whole way. Plan a route with three close shops before you start.
steps: Find three shops close together and plan the route first. [S1]
With your partner, rob the first shop, then the second, then the third — back to back. [S1]
Keep your Wanted Level through all three robberies; the trophy pops after the third. [S1]
tips: If the chain breaks, you will need another partner moment — another reason this one is flagged missable. [S3]

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.answer: Discover 100 different vehicles. [S1][S2]
trophies.guide: One hundred vehicles discovered — get in a new one and it counts. Leonida's roads are full of variety, so this trophy rewards curiosity: drive something different every time you travel, and the counter climbs fast.
steps: Get into a vehicle you have never driven before; it counts as discovered. [S1]
Keep switching to new vehicles as you travel around Leonida. [S1]
Use the counter here to watch the 100 fill up. [S2]
The trophy pops on the 100th different vehicle. [S1]
tips: PowerPyx's roadmap puts vehicle discovery in the activities phase — it stacks with exploring the map. [S3]

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.answer: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. [S1]
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-time aiming mode, and this trophy wants five takedowns inside a single use of it. Wait for a fight with a crowd, trigger Combat Focus, and work through five enemies before the meter runs out.
steps: Find a fight with at least five enemies in reach. [S1]
Trigger Combat Focus. [S1]
Take down five enemies before the single use ends. [S1]
The trophy pops on the fifth takedown in that use. [S1]
tips: A crowded firefight is the right place; do not waste Combat Focus on one or two enemies. [S1]

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.answer: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport. [S1]
trophies.guide: A cryptic trophy with a plain trick: at Vice City International Airport, leave by a way that is not scheduled — take a plane that is not yours and fly out. It is missable because the airport moment may not come back, so do it while you are there for the VCIA Takedown mission.
steps: Go to Vice City International Airport (VCIA). [S1]
Find a plane and take it for an unscheduled departure. [S1]
Fly out and the trophy pops. [S1]
tips: Do this during trophy 12's mission, while you are already at the airport. [S1]

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.answer: Get into a Rhino tank and make it count. [S1]
trophies.guide: The Rhino is the army tank, and this trophy is about getting hot in one. The description is a joke — 'kinda hot in these Rhinos' — and the trophy is for a moment in a Rhino tank. When a Rhino appears in the story, climb in and use it.
steps: Reach the story moment where a Rhino tank appears. [S1]
Climb into the Rhino. [S1]
Use it as the moment asks and the trophy pops. [S1]
tips: No source pins down the exact Rhino moment, so this guide flags it: take the chance the first time a Rhino appears. [S1]

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.answer: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. [S1]
trophies.guide: A stealth robbery: get into a jewelry store, take the goods, and get out without anyone spotting you. It is missable because the clean run needs the right moment — plan the approach, move quietly, and leave before the alarm.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet approach. [S1]
Rob the store without being detected. [S1]
Escape clean and the trophy pops. [S1]
tips: If you are spotted, the run is blown — another reason this one is flagged missable. [S3]

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.answer: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. [S1][S2]
trophies.guide: Five bank vaults, five escapes. Bank vaults are the biggest robberies in the game: plan the entry, crack the vault, grab the money, and get out alive. Each vault is its own job, and the trophy pops after the fifth clean escape.
steps: Find a bank vault robbery and plan the entry. [S1]
Rob the vault and escape. [S1]
Repeat for five vaults in total; the counter here tracks them. [S2]
The trophy pops after the fifth escape. [S1]
tips: PowerPyx's roadmap puts the vault robberies in the late cleanup phase, once you are well armed. [S3][S5]

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.answer: Rob an armored truck and escape. [S1]
trophies.guide: A classic GTA move: stop an armored truck, crack it open, take the money, and escape. Armored trucks drive Leonida's roads, so you can attempt this one whenever you spot one — no story moment needed.
steps: Spot an armored truck on the road. [S1]
Stop it and rob it. [S1]
Escape with the money and the trophy pops. [S1]
If the first try fails, another truck will come along — this one can be retried any time. [S1]
tips: A fast getaway car parked nearby makes the escape much easier. [S1]

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.answer: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. [S1][S2]
trophies.guide: All of Leonida: 52 areas, from Vice City's beaches to the swamps and small towns of the state. Exploration counts when you set foot in an area, so the trophy is really a tour — drive, walk, and fly until the map is filled in.
steps: Open the map and note which areas are still unvisited. [S1]
Travel to each unvisited area; entering it counts. [S1]
Use the counter here to track the 52 areas. [S2]
The trophy pops when the last area is explored. [S1]
tips: Pair this with the WAiNK locations (trophy 31) and vehicle discovery (trophy 35) — the routes overlap. [S1]

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.answer: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. [S1][S2]
trophies.guide: Nine gangs, nine illegal operations to rob — one per gang. Each gang runs its own rackets somewhere in Leonida; find an operation, rob it, and move to the next gang. The trophy is a tour of the state's underworld.
steps: Find an illegal operation belonging to one gang. [S1]
Rob it. [S1]
Repeat for each of the 9 gangs; the counter here tracks them. [S2]
The trophy pops after the ninth gang's operation is robbed. [S1]
tips: PowerPyx's roadmap groups gang operations with the mid-game activities. [S3]

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.answer: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. [S1]
trophies.guide: The gentlest missable trophy: go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. It is missable only because the moment is tied to the early game — do it the first time you are on Ocean Beach and it is done in ten minutes.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach. [S1]
Order a cocktail at a beach bar with a view. [S1]
Enjoy it and the trophy pops. [S1]
tips: Do this early, in Phase 1, while the beach is part of the story's opening stretch. [S3]

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.answer: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in classic style. [S1]
trophies.guide: A classic-style moment: take a car in a vehicle showroom and smash your way out through the glass. It is a one-time set piece — the showroom smash only happens when the story puts you there — so take it when it comes.
steps: Reach the showroom moment in the story. [S1]
Get in a vehicle in the showroom. [S1]
Smash your way out through the glass, in classic style, and the trophy pops. [S1]
tips: No source pins down the exact showroom moment; take the chance the first time a showroom scene plays. [S1]

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.answer: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. [S1]
trophies.guide: Bowling, GTA-style: go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — bowl a full game. It is a small, quiet moment of a trophy, and it is missable only because the alley visit is tied to a story moment.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. [S1]
Bowl a game and follow through. [S1]
The trophy pops when the game is done. [S1]
tips: Bowling is also an activity, so it may count toward trying each activity type (trophy 16). [S1]

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.answer: Do something with your partner that has mass appeal. [S1]
trophies.guide: A cryptic partner trophy: 'a partnership with mass appeal' — something you do together with your partner that the public notices. The description names nothing specific, so no source pins down the exact act; do the big public partner moments when they come, and this one should follow.
steps: Play the story moments where you and your partner act together in public. [S1]
Take the big, public partner moments when they appear. [S1]
The trophy pops when the right partnership moment lands. [S1]
tips: Honest note: no source pins down the exact act for this trophy — the guide says so instead of guessing. [S1]

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.answer: Make choices — PSN tracks 500 of something, but no source says what. [S1][S2]
trophies.guide: The strangest trophy in the list. The description says only 'Choices made (for better or worse)', and PSNProfiles lists a target of 500 — but no source anywhere says what the 500 counts. It is most likely choices or interactions across the game, counted as you play. This guide will not guess: make choices whenever the game offers them, keep playing, and watch the counter.
steps: Make choices whenever the game offers them, for better or worse. [S1]
Keep playing the story and side content; choices appear throughout. [S1]
Watch the counter here — PSN tracks 500 of something, and the number should climb as you choose. [S2]
UNRESOLVED: if the counter never moves, no source pins down what the 500 counts; see disagreement 5. [S1][S2]
tips: This is the one trophy where the guide openly says it does not know — that is better than a made-up answer. [S1]

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.answer: Fail once, then succeed on the second try. [S1]
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: fail something once, then succeed at it on the second attempt. The description is a riddle, and no source names the exact event — the honest read is that some story or side moment has a first-try failure built in, and the trophy pops when you get it right the second time.
steps: Play the story and side content normally. [S1]
If a moment fails the first time, try it again right away. [S1]
The trophy pops when the second attempt succeeds. [S1]
tips: No source pins down the exact event for this trophy — the guide says so instead of guessing. [S1]

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.answer: Stumble into something strange — the description is the whole clue. [S1]
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? That is the whole description, and it points at something strange — the kind of weird, out-of-place moment GTA games hide in the corners of the map. No source names the exact event, so the honest advice is: explore Leonida's odd places, and take the strange moments when they appear.
steps: Explore Leonida's odd corners and strange places. [S1]
Take the strange moments when they appear. [S1]
The trophy pops when the weird event happens. [S1]
tips: No source pins down the exact event for this trophy — the guide says so instead of guessing. [S1]

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.answer: Bowl people over with a melee drive-by. [S1]
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by: drive past a group of people and bowl them over with a melee attack from the vehicle. It needs a crowd and a moving car, so find a busy street, line the drive-by up, and swing as you pass.
steps: Find a busy street with people on foot. [S1]
Drive by and bowl them over with a melee attack from the vehicle. [S1]
The trophy pops when the drive-by lands. [S1]
tips: A slow pass through a crowd gives you more time to land the swing than a fast one. [S1]

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.answer: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. [S1][S2]
trophies.guide: A quarter of a million dollars, laundered: Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and your contacts wash them into clean money. Keep robbing, keep laundering, and the total climbs. It pairs naturally with the bank vaults and armored trucks.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies and heists. [S1]
Launder them through your contacts. [S1]
Keep going until $250,000 is laundered; the counter here tracks the total. [S2]
The trophy pops at $250,000. [S1]
tips: Bank vaults (trophy 40) are a good source of Marked Bills. [S1]

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.answer: Spend $100,000 across all shops. [S1][S2]
trophies.guide: One hundred thousand dollars spent, across all shops: clothes, weapons, cars, food — everything counts. You will spend much of this naturally over a full playthrough; if you are short at the end, buy the big-ticket items you have been putting off.
steps: Spend money in shops as you play — clothes, weapons, vehicles, all of it counts. [S1]
Watch the counter here; $100,000 is the target. [S2]
If you are short late in the game, buy big-ticket items you still need. [S1]
tips: This pairs with buying garage properties (trophy 54) — property purchases count as spending. [S1]

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.answer: Buy all 8 garage properties. [S1][S2]
trophies.guide: Eight garage properties, bought across Leonida. Garages store your vehicles, and each one costs money — save up, buy them one by one, and the trophy pops when the eighth deed is yours.
steps: Find garage properties for sale around Leonida. [S1]
Buy them one by one as you can afford them. [S1]
Use the counter here to track the 8 properties. [S2]
tips: Garages also help with registering vehicles for the Scooter Bros app (trophy 55). [S1]

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.answer: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. [S1][S2]
trophies.guide: Ten vehicles registered to the Scooter Bros app. Drive a vehicle you own, open the app, and register it; repeat with ten different vehicles. It is the last of the money trophies, and one of the quickest.
steps: Own or find a vehicle to register. [S1]
Open the Scooter Bros app and register the vehicle. [S1]
Repeat with 10 different vehicles; the counter here tracks them. [S2]
tips: Vehicles you discover for trophy 35 are good candidates to register here. [S1]
